shots.action: A night bus window fills the frame, seen from inside the darkened vehicle, the camera locked off and never moving. Cold raindrops bead across the glass in irregular clusters, some clinging in place and trembling, others breaking loose and dragging short crooked trails through the condensation. Beyond the pane the city is a soft wash of out-of-focus light — amber streetlamps, a red smudge of a tail light, a pale green glow — all smeared and wavering as the water bends and scatters it. The dark interior reflects faintly on the inner surface, a dim ghost of the cabin overlapping the moving lights. Nothing inside the bus is disturbed; only the rain travels.

blurred city lights beyond the pane

shots.what_changes: Droplets gather on the glass and the first few begin to slide, smearing the lights behind them.

shots.action: The shot cuts to a tighter, close-in view of the same locked-off bus window, the same night city still blurred to colored haze behind the glass. A single large droplet sits heavy at the center of the pane, quivering, then draws a smaller neighbour into itself and swells; released, it runs a wavering vertical line down the condensation, gathering other beads as it goes and leaving a clear, sharply defined channel that momentarily sharpens the smear of amber and red light behind it. The camera holds absolutely still, and only the water moves within the frame.
subjects: a single large raindrop on the bus window glass
condensation and smaller beads on the pane
